machine: One AMD EPYC Genoa vCPU for the server on Linux 6.8.0-147. Four Go clients on twelve other logical CPUs of the same host, private loopback.
scoring: The organizer's unmodified mload merges every shard's full ramp-and-hold latency histogram. A 75-second hold is an exploratory pilot. The five-minute confirmation uses hold_seconds=300. The named steady sample describes only the stated interval and never determines the score. Reported HTTP counts and latency arrays are separate atomic snapshots in upstream mload.
